point_of_view: Contemporary in-world observer; present-tense peoples, institutions and languages. An in-world reader may refer to an older book or former ruler, but never to modern geography or future historical classifications.
legacy_merge: Apply the same prose review to ALL retained culture, ethnicity, language, accent, script, naming-element guidance and new group descriptions when materialising the seeder. Preserve the authored geographic, social, phonetic and appearance detail wherever applicable; move caveats to developer notes rather than appending them to Description.
source_preservation: Archive the original wording separately. Non-destructive preservation does not require old administrative or retrospective wording to remain the active player-facing text.
appearance: Retain grounded existing appearance descriptions in contemporary voice where supplied; this revision does not invent new demographic or physiological claims.
lookup_labels: Canonical labels and era menu labels can contain historical stage terms for usability; do not derive the player description from those labels or seed the canonical label over the selected era presentation.
ui_instructions: Keep pick counts, costs, validity messages and builder instructions in dedicated UI text, outside the setting Description fields.
encoding: NFC and Latin-1 for all supplied game-facing text; research metadata and source spellings remain Unicode.
